summary: Frontend E2E verified for 4 new features (SOS history + reactivity leaderboard, AGV in 3D Twin, Silos micro-orders via email, Proofing→Plan sync) plus regression on role-layout and 390px mobile overflow. All flows PASS.

test_results.auth_gate_and_login: PASS (fetch /api/admin-gate/verify 200, /api/auth/login 200, localStorage set, reload OK, no React runtime errors; only 401s pre-auth fetches which are expected)
test_results.sos_history_reactivity: PASS: created SOS via /api/bako/sos, sos-ack-<id> handler visible via polling, click ack -> response_seconds computed. sos-history-toggle appears (label 'History & Reactivity (N)'). Opening shows sos-history with sos-board-mattina (leaderboard by shift w/ avg response) and sos-hist-0/1 rows with per-event response duration.
test_results.digital_twin_agv: PASS: twin-canvas mounts cleanly (WebGL). GET /api/bako/agv returns 200 with {carts, alerts, alert_count, spoken}. No runtime errors.
test_results.silos_microorder: PASS: after PUT /api/bako/silos/silo-00 {current_kg:100}, silo-microorder button appears. POST /api/bako/silos/microorder returns {ok:true, count:1, orders:[{silo:'Farina Tipo 00', qty_kg:1100}], emailed:true, supplier:'admin@mikilab.de'}. Silo restored to 1200kg after test.
test_results.proofing_sync_plan: PASS: proof-oven-ready shows 'Bake at: HH:MM'. proof-sync-plan button clickable and returns success toast. proof-ovens-0 => 'FRENA (forni occupati) · 218 min'; proof-ovens-2 => 'ACCELERA (forni liberi) · 101 min'; proof-ovens-auto restores auto mode. Mode chips change total_minutes and thus bake time as expected.
test_results.regression_role_layout: PASS: role-layout present in 'tutto' view; all target panels visible (emergency, twin, silos, proofing, agv). Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390).
test_results.console_errors: Only 401s from pre-auth fetches before login completes (benign). No React pageerrors.

critical_code_review_comments: HoloPanel defaultOpen inconsistency: some panels (emergency, autoplan) are defaultOpen, others (proofing, silos, twin) are not — testing needs an ensure_open helper. Consider adding a data-open attribute to panel-* to reveal open state for testability.
AGV endpoint returns object {carts, alerts, ...} not an array; if any consumer expects an array it will fail (frontend seems fine, but worth documenting).
AdaptiveProofing renders proof-sync-plan/oven-ready only after first fetch completes; consider a skeleton with data-testid to make tests deterministic without long waits.
seed_data_creation: Created 5 test SOS events (TESTOP, TESTOP2..TESTOP5 on FORNO-1), all ack'd. Temporarily reduced silo-00 to 100kg to trigger micro-order, then restored to 1200kg.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features + regression PASS. Emergency panel is defaultOpen; Proofing/Silos/Twin require expanding via panel-*-head. Use polling waits (SOS ~5s, proofing ~8s) with wait_for_selector on data-testids. History toggle only appears after at least one resolved SOS (hist.resolved_count > 0). Micro-order needs at least one silo below threshold — force via PUT /api/bako/silos/silo-00 {current_kg:100}.
